acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retained; source closure remains necessary but does not assert every frozen corpus feasibility floor.
Retained; target alignment remains necessary but does not assert all feasibility/no-truncation requirements.
Retained; content-disjoint sealing is necessary but lacks salt-commitment provenance and real-seal access attestation.
Retained; duplicate canaries do not duplicate serving with a nonzero adapter.
Retained as the narrow prefix-package endpoint only.
Retained as the narrow selected-corpus-package endpoint only.
Retained; its frozen vocabulary must explicitly preserve all stated scope and scale ceilings.
Retained; it does not scan every exact engine-consumed policy-visible byte.
Retained as a partition check, but it does not bind target/module/action scoring execution.
Retained; prompt conformance stops at parsing and does not prove dispatch/scoring identity.
Retained; the authority graph must additionally encode within-A2 receipt dependencies and the authoring-versus-execution boundary.
Retained; required implementation separation and synthetic fault coverage remain necessary.
Retained; synthetic faults do not attest real-seal access and publication behavior.
Retained; it lacks an exact precedence table for overlapping abandonment, infrastructure, and incompleteness predicates.

agreements: The proposal is only a quarantined offline, post-hoc source-oracle-selected continuation-writer/interface assay; it is not a complete dream-memory-think organism evaluation.
C2-minus-C1 is an exact neutral-chat-prefix-package contrast, not an isolated serialization, position, or compute mechanism contrast.
C2-minus-C0 is a total selected-corpus-plus-training-package contrast, not causal evidence for verification, outcome grounding, memory-path use, task conditioning, discovery, or online learning.
The source-oracle/target-evaluation visibility partition, score-blind sealing, fresh-reset one-decision endpoint, staged human authority, and no-writeback boundary are necessary protections.
Content-hash disjointness from the bound contamination manifest does not establish semantic novelty, opacity of target identity, or absence of pretrained knowledge.
Human ratification is required at every authority transition; this consensus authorizes neither edits nor execution.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. A2 authorization alone does not order the static checks, synthetic seal faults, real sealing, canaries, and A3 promotion.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound acceptance test that encodes the within-stage command and receipt DAG: AT8, AT9, AT12, and AT13; then real sealing and AT3; then only finite GPU canaries; then AT4 and independent review before A3. AT11 is the closest existing partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Extractor and authority-validator authoring cannot be prohibited by tests that require those newly authored tools before implementation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define implementation as distinct from declarative authoring and require AT1 and AT11 before downstream tokenizer/model-path implementation, while A0 alone permits their bounded CPU/no-model/no-tokenizer authoring and execution.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Green extraction and alignment receipts can coexist with an infeasible corpus.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound pass/fail feasibility acceptance test for every life: row count, supervised-token count, payload diversity/share, EOS, length, and no-truncation floors, with failure classified INVALID_INFRA. AT1 and AT2 are only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Scanning named bootstrap and renderer files is not equivalent to scanning the complete served policy context.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound acceptance test that rejects selected payloads, historical actions/outcomes, corpus text, and every concrete pass name in the exact engine-consumed target token sequence, including template-added text and special-token decoding. AT8 and AT10 are only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. The proposal does not bind the sealed module, parsed action, normalized vector, evaluator identity, and scored outcome in one receipt.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound end-to-end acceptance test binding sealed URI/module hash, scorer fresh-reset hash, parser payload, engine-consumed normalized pass vector, evaluator/dependency identity, I0/I1, and final score. AT10 is only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. C0 and zero-delta checks do not exercise deterministic mounted nonzero-adapter serving.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound canary that duplicates serving with mounted nonzero B0/C1 and B0/C2 adapters and proves the intended tensor identity was applied. AT4 and AT10 are only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Zero-scored invalid or rejected actions can improve the registered mean without improving useful accepted action value.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound acceptance test that reports and gates evaluator acceptance, accepted positive and worsening actions, invalid strict actions, malformed output, and abstention, so rejection avoidance cannot satisfy a useful-package conclusion. AT5 and AT6 are only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. A ratified salt is not evidence that it was generated once before candidate enumeration or salt search.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound acceptance test proving independent one-shot salt generation, pre-enumeration commitment, non-reuse, and absence of candidate-salt search. AT3 and AT13 are only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Synthetic faults and matching final manifests do not attest the actual seal's access and publication history.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound acceptance test validating real write-ahead access logs, exposure records, comparator agreement, and atomic publication during the actual seal. AT3 and AT13 are only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as a nonattribution boundary. URI/family cues and pretrained knowledge remain compatible with any positive result.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Treat every positive result as compatible with URI/family cues, pretrained compiler knowledge, and generic pass priors; prohibit semantic-generalization and memory-path-use attribution. AT7 is the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as a nonattribution boundary. Source outcomes select historical rows after the fact and target outcomes are quarantined.
concern_dispositions.required_change: State that the assay is offline supervised adaptation to source-oracle-selected traces, not online action/outcome learning or continual improvement. AT7 and AT14 are the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. The operational object is closed-world provenance selection plus assay-local adaptation, not persistent memory growth or organism consolidation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace memory-growth and consolidation wording with closed-world extraction/provenance resolution and assay-local supervised parametric transport before exact-byte ratification. AT7 is the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as a scope ceiling, not a defect in the narrow writer-floor endpoint.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve that no parent structure, retrieval, planning, revision, or complete-organism cognition is measured or creditable. AT7 is the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as an explicit unmeasured mechanism boundary.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Do not claim memory-substrate advantage, thinker-compute separation, or memory-path necessity; fixed-budget substrate and bridge/recurrence/connectivity interventions require a separately deliberated benchmark. AT7 is the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. The registered cells identify only the two specified packages.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Do not assign causal credit to outcome selection, useful action content, generic continuation training, strict-marker imitation, or the birth payload; matched corpus controls require a separately deliberated benchmark. AT5, AT6, and AT7 are the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. First-action score and strict-marker rate do not distinguish recall, composition, planning, or semantic generalization.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep all unmeasured cognitive capabilities outside report and diagnostic claims. AT7 is the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Occurrence provenance is retained but repeat state never conditions training or serving.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Prohibit claims of learning across repeat blocks or recurrent episode-state use. AT7 is the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. The fixed panel and related lives do not establish replication, robustness, population, scale, or lifetime effects.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make report templates and forbidden-prose scanning explicitly prohibit scaling, replication, robustness, population, lifetime-length, seed, and hardware claims. AT7 and AT15 are existing partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as a reservation of inactive mechanisms, not evidence of a defect in this isolated assay.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Require dedicated branch-release, valid-diamond/shared-ancestry, and policy-visible-repeat tests before those control-plane mechanisms are activated or claimed. AT7 is the closest existing coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Membership in the allowed state set does not establish the correct result for overlapping failure predicates.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a newly hash-bound acceptance test exhaustively asserting precedence for overlapping seal, infrastructure, review, serving, missing-cell, and contrast predicates. AT15 is only partial coverage.

disagreements.issue: Whether the stated linear human authority graph sufficiently prevents implementation cycles, premature GPU canaries, and premature A3 promotion.

positions.position: A0→A1→A2→A3→REPORT and AT11 provide an acyclic staged authority chain.
The graph omits both the authoring-versus-test boundary and enforceable receipt dependencies within A2, allowing premature canaries or promotion.

resolution.rationale: The critic identifies executable-order gaps not represented by the registered linear graph. Existing tests do not encode the required dependency DAG.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a newly registered, machine-checked within-stage authority/receipt dependency test and an exact A0 authoring boundary; preserve A1 tokenizer authorization and A2-only finite GPU-canary authorization.

disagreements.issue: Whether extraction and target-alignment receipts enforce the frozen per-life corpus feasibility floor.

positions.position: AT1 validates retained-row grammar and AT2 validates target projections, totals, and no intended C1/C2 supervision mismatch.
Neither test makes row, token, diversity, payload-share, EOS, length, and no-truncation floors pass/fail requirements.

resolution.rationale: The mandatory floor can otherwise fail while the registered receipts pass.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a newly registered feasibility-floor test and explicit INVALID_INFRA mapping for any per-life failure.

disagreements.issue: Whether bootstrap and renderer scanning proves that no answer-like action reaches the served policy context.

positions.position: AT8 scans bound bootstrap and renderer against the source-payload registry, while AT10 verifies serving IDs.
Named-file scanning leaves template-added and special-token-decoded policy bytes, including concrete pass text, outside an unambiguous rejection rule.

resolution.rationale: The required object is the complete engine-consumed prompt, not merely selected input files.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a newly registered exact-policy-byte scan without a task-metadata exception for concrete pass names.

disagreements.issue: Whether sealed target identity and parsed action are proven to be the module and action actually scored.

positions.position: AT3 seals reset-state modules and AT10 proves prompt-to-parser conformance.
The scorer may resolve mutable evaluator paths and normalize actions, so neither test binds sealed module, parsed payload, consumed vector, and I0/I1 together.

resolution.rationale: A valid assay requires end-to-end identity across sealing, serving, parsing, dispatch, and score.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a newly registered target-dispatch-scoring round-trip receipt.

disagreements.issue: Whether the deterministic canary covers serving paths used by adapted endpoint cells.

positions.position: Duplicate C1/C2 training, duplicate C0 serving, and zero-delta LoRA equivalence establish finite assay reproducibility.
Only C0 and zero-delta mounts are served twice; nonzero adapter mount, kernels, and decoding remain untested.

resolution.rationale: Scientific endpoints depend on a nonzero mounted adapter, which the current duplicate-serving check does not exercise.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a newly registered duplicate nonzero-adapter serving canary for B0/C1 and B0/C2.

disagreements.issue: Whether zero-scored invalid/rejected output may satisfy a claimed useful package effect.

positions.position: Malformed, empty, and rejected actions score zero while strict-marker rate separately reports interface syntax.
A mean-score and marker-rate gain can be produced by avoiding harmful valid actions through strict-looking rejection or abstention.

resolution.rationale: The registered endpoint cannot distinguish improved accepted action value from rejection avoidance.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a newly registered validity/abstention decomposition and pre-registered acceptance/value floors for useful-effect reporting.

disagreements.issue: Whether salted, atomic sealing is demonstrably nonadaptive and fail-closed in the actual target-enumeration run.

positions.position: A fresh ratified salt, independent sealers, atomic publication, and synthetic fault injection protect sealing.
The proposal does not prove pre-enumeration one-shot salt commitment or validate real access logs, exposure records, and publication behavior.

resolution.rationale: Synthetic tests and final agreement cannot establish actual nonadaptive salt provenance or absence of real-seal exposure.
resolution.required_change: Rework with newly registered salt-provenance and real-seal-access/publication tests before any target or GPU authority can be considered.

disagreements.issue: Whether the writer-floor results can support claims about the complete organism, memory use, online learning, causal corpus content, generalization, recurrence, or replication.

positions.position: The claim delta limits results to an offline selected-continuation writer/interface and cross-program action-prior floor on the exact sealed panel.
The assay is a severed offline source-selection and assay-local transport path; target URI remains a policy cue and feedback is quarantined.
The one-decision route lacks memory substrate comparisons, recurrence, causal corpus controls, opaque identities, policy-visible repeat state, and population replication.

resolution.rationale: The narrow package estimands remain possible only under an explicit ceiling. However AT7's present exclusion list does not explicitly name all scale, robustness, population, lifetime, seed, and hardware prohibitions.
resolution.required_change: Rework the fixed report vocabulary and forbidden-prose scanner to preserve every stated nonattribution, including URI/pretraining compatibility and explicit scale/replication/robustness/population/lifetime ceilings. Reserve mechanism, substrate, online-learning, causal-corpus, generalization, repeat-state, and control-plane tests for separate deliberated benchmarks.
resolution.selected_position: Critique and both interpretations: retain only the narrow writer-floor claim.

disagreements.issue: Whether extraction and assay-local LoRA transport may be described as dream-memory growth or organism-level consolidation.

positions.position: The graph uses dream-like local connection growth/re-expression and parametric consolidation/transport language.
The operation resolves existing historical provenance and trains quarantined assay-local adapters; it creates no persistent memory object or organism consolidation.

resolution.rationale: The actual operation is narrower than the disputed system-language framing.
resolution.required_change: Replace the disputed prose before exact-byte ratification with closed-world provenance extraction and assay-local supervised parametric transport; prohibit memory-growth and organism-consolidation credit.

disagreements.issue: Whether the state machine determines the correct durable state when abandonment, infrastructure failure, review failure, and missing cells overlap.

positions.position: AT15 exhaustively maps gate/contrast combinations into seven registered states.
The proposal does not state precedence for overlapping predicates, so an allowed label can still be the wrong durable response.

resolution.rationale: Completeness of the label set is insufficient without deterministic precedence across overlapping failure classes.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a newly registered exhaustive precedence test and an exact precedence table for ABANDONED_SEAL, INVALID_INFRA, and INCOMPLETE.

questions: Whether to ratify a repaired, newly hash-bound proposal only after it registers the missing operational tests and repairs the disputed language and report vocabulary.
Whether the desired future scientific objective is a narrow offline writer floor or a separately deliberated full-organism benchmark with substrate, causal, recurrence, and generalization controls.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the operation is closed-world provenance selection, not dream-time connection growth.
Accepted: C1/C2 are assay-local supervised parametric transport, not organism-level consolidation.
Accepted: cross-program action-prior language must remain descriptive and compatible with URI, pretrained, copying, and generic-package explanations.
Accepted: the quarantined one-decision writer floor does not force or measure the complete organism.
Accepted: direct bootstrap copying is closed, but URI/family and pretrained-prior shortcuts remain compatible with a result.
Accepted: substrate comparisons and mechanism ablations belong to a separately deliberated benchmark.
